tool_args.rationale: The pilot ends at H = 0.48, far short of the target H = 24.3. Long-horizon observations are needed to identify slow adaptation and test for reversal before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon endogenous adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All horizons are short and correlated with input, leaving the slow adaptation and long-horizon reversal poorly identified.
A longer-horizon probe is more directly discriminating for the target horizon and the candidate reversal mechanism.
The short-window observations alone cannot distinguish these from slow adaptation at the forecast horizon.
